summary.zh: 本次更新让更新内容更容易查看，并提升了桌面端的稳定性。
summary.en: This update makes release details easier to review and improves desktop stability.

highlights.zh: 现在可在下载前查看本次更新的主要内容。
highlights.en: You can now review the key changes before downloading an update.

highlights.zh: 更新下载会显示实际进度，关闭详情后仍会继续。
highlights.en: Update downloads show real progress and continue after you close the details.

highlights.zh: 设置与标题栏会展示同一份更新说明。
highlights.en: Settings and the title bar now show the same release details.

highlights.zh: 修复部分桌面环境在更新检查失败后服务中断的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed an issue that could interrupt the desktop service after an update check failed.
